Name: LaD Zayne's Mod - Ridgeside Village-Compatible English Translation
Author: MiscMemos
Description:
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]This is the RSV-compatible version of my standalone English localization of the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40300]Love and Deepspace Zayne's Mod 4.2.0[/url] by [b]MoLiNaiLvMianMianBing[/b]. [/*]
[*]If you [b]don't use Ridgeside Village[/b], use the main [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51300]Love and Deepspace Zayne's Mod - English Translation[/url] instead.[/*]
[*][b]Runtime status:[/b] I don't play RSV, so I have not personally tested this release through a live RSV playthrough. The package has been reviewed for the known conflicts between the two mods and those conflicts have been addressed at the file level. RSV-specific test reports are welcome.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]

[size=4][b][font=Arial]This is a standalone package, not a patch to install over another Zayne mod.[/font][/b][/size]

[size=4][b][font=Arial]Remove [u]any [/u][/font][/b][/size][font=Arial][b][size=4][u]other[/u] [i]version of the Love and Deepspace Zayne's Mod[/i][/size][/b][/font][size=4][b][font=Arial] from your folder first, including:[/font][/b][/size]
[spoiler][list]
[*]the original Chinese release[font=Arial] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40300]Love and Deepspace Zayne's Mod 4.2.0[/url];[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]Zayne_EN ([/font][font=Arial][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51300]Love and Deepspace Zayne's Mod - English Translation[/url]);[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]another copy of Zayne_ENRSV (this mod)[/font][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[spoiler]
[b][u]Required Dependencies:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.3.2+[/*]
[*]Content Patcher 2.8.0+[/*]
[*]SpaceCore 1.28.4 (latest)[/*]
[*]Central Station 1.7.0 (latest)[/*]
[*]Ridgeside Village 2.5.17 (latest) and its required dependencies[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[heading][line]
[/heading]
[heading]What version 4.2.5 changes for RSV[/heading]
[spoiler][list]
[*][b]Separate Zayne identities:[/b] RSV and the LaD Zayne mod both have an NPC named Zayne. This release gives the LaD Zayne a separate internal NPC identity so both can exist in the same game.[/*]
[*][b]Winter 28:[/b] RSV's [b]Ember of Resolutions[/b] remains the active festival. The LaD Zayne mod's separate Winter 28 festival is not loaded; Zayne is added to Ember of Resolutions instead.[/*]
[*][b]Egg Festival:[/b] Zayne's placement has been moved so he does not overlap with June.[/*]
[*][b]Fall 20 — Ridgeside Gathering:[/b] Zayne attends the opening portion of the festival, then leaves before the concert begins.[/*]
[/list]The original Zayne Winter 28 assets are still included in the package for maintenance/reference, but they are not loaded as a separate festival.[/spoiler]

[heading][line]
[/heading]
[heading]English localization[/heading]
[list]
[*]The English dialogue, localization, and general maintenance fixes are shared with the main [b]Zayne_EN[/b] ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51300]Love and Deepspace Zayne's Mod - English Translation[/url]) release. The included Important Notes and Guide also summarizes the original mod's gameplay, events, schedules, and items.[/*]
[*]If you find a problem with the [b]English localization itself[/b]—missing text, incorrect dialogue behavior, etc.—please report it on the main Zayne_EN page.[/*]
[*]If you find something specific to [b]RSV compatibility[/b], feel free to post it here so other users and I know about it. I can't promise ongoing compatibility work for future RSV changes, but reports are still useful.[/*]
[/list][heading][line]
Alternative RSV approach[/heading]
[list]
[*]The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40300]original Chinese mod page [/url]also mentions a community-modified version of RSV which resolves the conflict differently. This release does [b]not[/b] modify RSV. RSV's own Winter 28 festival remains in place, and this version adapts Zayne around it[/*]
[/list]
